plotwork.body: Write a diagram in a few lines of text and Plotwork draws it, checks it in your CI and tells you when it drifts from the code it describes.

points.second: A drift check on every pull request
points.third: A live whiteboard and an MCP server

flung.body: Your app or AI agent connects social accounts, then schedules and publishes posts to 27 networks through one REST API, an SDK or an MCP server.

gunspec.body: Specifications for more than 8,500 firearms, with calibers, ammunition and what fits what, every figure traced to where it came from.

points.third: An API and an MCP server

dissolve.body: A disposable address in one click, for the sign-up you do not trust. Use it in the browser, from the extension or through the API, and let it go when you are done.

cryptflare.body: Encrypted, versioned secrets with fine-grained access for teams, built on Cloudflare and run for you as a managed service.

points.second: Access by person and by project
points.third: Run for you on the edge
